description: Recorded fixed-seed opponent matrix for the Supreme coalition and the scripted Normal baseline. Fair Fog (intelligence 0), 0% economic bonus, map shattered-mountain, seeds 805-807, 30000 ticks. Regenerate with ai/selfplay.py --bot-type <ai|normal> --vs rush,normal,turtle,naval --runs 3 --ticks 30000 --seed-base 805 --intelligence 0

known_gaps.note: Correction to an earlier reading. Aircraft ARE produced (heli queued 5x over a 20000-tick four-bot match). The earlier 'air 0' observation came from Coordinated-force gate lines, which stop logging once the gate opens, so they only ever showed the pre-production build-up. The real gap is that no offensive wave launches at all in symmetric self-play, because the enemy base is never located and AdvanceOnInferredBase is off by default - so the combined-arms wave path is never exercised in that configuration.
